title: M9-C42.21 — Milestone M21.7 Cross-Dimension Reconciliation
scope: Correlate mutation evidence with coverage, capability mapping, test inventory, and verification profiles across 12 authorized + 2 deferred components.

key_patterns: HIGH COVERAGE + LOW MUTATION = tests exercise lines but lack behavioral discrimination (cashflow, ledger_audit, recommendation, common_calculations, financial_events, behaviour).
LOW COVERAGE + HIGH MUTATION = focused test surface with strong assertions beats broad coverage (balance_engine: 58.9% cov, 95.4% mut).
HIGH COVERAGE + HIGH MUTATION = strong verification (account, loan, reconciliation, core_domain_money).
HIGH COVERAGE + BELOW GATE = near-threshold (credit_card 75.6%); targeted genuine-gap kills can close.
NO_TESTS MUTANTS = discovery gap, not coverage gap (behaviour 39%, financial_events 4%). Coverage sees lines; mutation sees test-to-mutant binding.
